snippet.title: Balancing cats - challenging free game with no ads for all ages, cute family game. Find balance now
snippet.description:
Ever wanted a cute, fun and simple game where You don't have to move a finger or barely touch or tap a screen? This new free android game is almost multiplayer like game for all ages / family. 
Popular with women, girls and boys around the world. You can compete with friends on highest score worldwide today, this week or even all times!

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.AnimusAudax.BalancingCats

 So don't hesitate - download and try this ads free simple and casual game. It is easy to star and hard to master. Plenty of room for skills and strategy - strategic thinking gets You higher scores and You can play without losing longer, to reach highest score globally. So far score based online leaderboard is tracking a top cat, but soon two more leaderboards will arrive: hoarder (biggest stack of balancing balls / balanced food on the plate today) and leveler (highest game level reached world). Cats don't eat fruits and vegetables that are thrown away by mouse, but You should :)
Again don't skip this addictive fun quick cat and mouse game and reach level 10 now! Check back with Your friends to see who collected biggest food pile or climbed to highest level or won first place on score board of this nice and cute cat game.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.AnimusAudax.BalancingCats

Check out my new style - Download NOW
